name: CIBRS Group A Public Crime Data
description: Sample of detailed CIBRS Group A data, received from ARJIS. Filtered for the public.

Additional Information.Methodology: Crimes reported by various police departments in the San Deigo region

columns.name: Incident UID
columns.description: Numeric ID for each NIBRS crime incident

columns.name: Agency
columns.description: Reporting Agency on crime case or arrest

columns.name: Incident Date
columns.description: Date/Time that crime case occurred

columns.name: CIBRS Unique Offense ID
columns.description: Unique Offense ID (IncidentUID + OffenseCode + VictimUID) *please note that incidents can have up to 10 reportable offenses

columns.name: Crime Against Category
columns.description: If the crime is a crime against Persons, Property or Society

columns.name: CIBRS Offense Code
columns.description: CIBRS/NIBRS offense codes

columns.name: CIBRS Offense Description
columns.description: Description of Offense Code

columns.name: Victim UID
columns.description: Unique Victim ID

columns.name: Victim Category
columns.description: I = Individual B = Business F = Financial Institution G = Government R = Religious Organization S = Society/Public O = Other U = Unknown

columns.name: Victim Age
columns.description: Victim Age (if victim is person)

columns.name: Victim Race
columns.description: Victim Race (if victim is person)

columns.name: Victim Sex
columns.description: Victim Age (if victim is person)

columns.name: Beat
columns.description: Police Beat where crime occurred

columns.name: City
columns.description: City where crime occurred

columns.name: Zip Code
columns.description: Zip code where crime ocurred

columns.name: Census Tract
columns.description: Census tract where the crime occurred

columns.name: CIBRS Status
columns.description: The status of the incident in the CIBRS CA DOJ Portal, and whether it has been accepted and ingested into the state data repository

columns.name: CIBRS Status Date
columns.description: The date the incident was ingested into the state data portal

columns.name: Domestic Violence Incident
columns.description: If any occurrence of domestic violence was flagged by the reporting officer on the crime case

columns.name: BCS Area
columns.description: Sheriff BCS Reporting Area where crime occurred (this will only be present on sheriff cases)

columns.name: Stolen Vehicles
columns.description: Count of stolen vehicles, this is the offense count for NIBRS Code 240
